description: 29 Indian Creek is an intimate collection of fourteen one- and two-bedroom residences and two two-story townhomes at 2901 Indian Creek Drive in Mid-Beach. Designed by Urban Robot (architecture, interiors and landscape from a single studio) for Trinity Southern with JMH Development, the project pairs Art Deco-inspired architecture with a contemporary boutique program: nine-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling glass, bone-white lacquered kitchens with fully integrated Miele appliances, and spa-caliber baths finished in Hansgrohe matte copper and limestone. Amenities include a rooftop pool deck, a Level 3 wellness suite with infrared sauna and cold plunge, 24/7 attended lobby concierge, valet with EV charging, and select-owner membership to The Beach Club at The Miami Beach EDITION.
editorialLine: Boutique Mid-Beach living with EDITION Beach Club access.

signals.title: A genuinely boutique building in Mid-Beach
signals.body: Sixteen homes in total, so resale competition inside the building is effectively near-zero. The scarcity argument here is structural, not narrative, in a corridor where most recent launches have been far larger towers.

signals.title: Select-owner membership at EDITION Beach Club
signals.body: Select owners receive membership to The Beach Club at The Miami Beach EDITION: 70,000 square feet of private beachfront, cabana reservations for the member and two guests, spa and fitness access, and members-only programming. It converts a non-oceanfront site into an oceanfront lifestyle.

signals.title: Urban Robot: architecture, interiors, and landscape from a single firm
signals.body: Urban Robot leads all three design disciplines. A single-firm approach produces a more cohesive outcome than the typical developer-architect-interior-designer split, which is visible in projects where signature materials, proportions, and detailing carry consistently from facade through residence interiors to landscape.

signals.title: Miele and Hansgrohe standard across every residence
signals.body: Every unit includes a Miele suite with wine cooler, bone-white lacquered kitchens with fluted glass uppers, and Hansgrohe matte copper fixtures with limestone baths, standard across the building, not only upper floors.

signals.title: Two two-story townhomes, three bedrooms and a 500 sq ft terrace
signals.body: Each townhome runs 1,750 sq ft interior as a 3 bed / 3.5 bath with a double-height great room, plus a 500 sq ft private terrace with summer kitchen and wet bar. Asking $3,650,000.

signals.title: Adjacent residences can be combined up to 3,500 sq ft
signals.body: The developer draws combination plans for a 2,344 sq ft three-bedroom, a 2,371 sq ft four-bedroom and a 3,500 sq ft five-bedroom townhome. Built to order from adjacent units, not standing inventory.

investmentIntelligence.thesis: 29 Indian Creek is one of the smallest-scale new-construction offerings currently under construction on Miami Beach, which is the strategic distinction. Buyers who have rejected the 200-unit tower experience but still want new construction with hotel-grade service are increasingly looking for under-twenty-unit buildings, and the inventory is genuinely scarce. The EDITION Beach Club tie-in is the most valuable single element in the amenity package: it converts a non-oceanfront address into a de facto oceanfront lifestyle at a fraction of the cost of a true ocean-side residence. Entry pricing of $1.55M and a blended $1,977 per square foot across the three available types place the building in the accessible-luxury band for Miami Beach, a range where boutique inventory at this finish level is hard to find.
